name: Nucleum

categories.label: VP track (gained during play)
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track VP (tích lũy trong ván)
categories.hint: Marker position before final scoring: includes contracts, King's Day scoring, endgame-condition VP (3 each).

categories.label: Milestone markers (condition x tier multiplier)
categories.labelVi: Cột mốc (điều kiện x hệ số tầng)
categories.hint: One entry per marker on the milestone track: times its segment tile's condition is met x tier multiplier. Include markers placed in final scoring with leftover Achievement tokens.

categories.label: Energized buildings
categories.hint: VP on flipped side; Praha buildings double. Include Government buildings (count matching type tiles in same network, energized or not, any owner).

categories.label: Income track bonus: Thaler
categories.hint: 0 = not in last 3 spaces, 1 = third-to-last (3 VP), 2 = second-to-last (6 VP), 3 = last space (10 VP).

categories.label: Income track bonus: Workers
categories.labelVi: Thưởng track thu nhập: Công nhân
categories.hint: 0 = not in last 3 spaces, 1 = third-to-last (3 VP), 2 = second-to-last (6 VP), 3 = last space (10 VP).

categories.label: Income track bonus: VP
categories.hint: 0 = not in last 3 spaces, 1 = third-to-last (3 VP), 2 = second-to-last (6 VP), 3 = last space (10 VP).

categories.label: 8th Technology ultimate goal
categories.hint: Only if you unlocked your 8th Technology; see appendix for your Experiment.

categories.label: Leftover Workers
categories.hint: 1 VP per 2 Workers in personal supply.

categories.label: Leftover Thaler
categories.hint: 1 VP per 5 Thaler in player area.

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker: tied players share the victory.

notes: Final scoring order: place leftover Achievement tokens on milestone track (no effects), score milestones (1 VP per condition met x tier multiplier 1-2:x1, 3-6:x2, 7-9:x3, 10-14:x4, 16-26:x5, 28-40:x6), 8th Technology goal, leftover resources (may convert Uranium to Workers and Workers to Thaler first), energized buildings, income track bonuses. Game ends when 2 of 5 conditions are met (3 in a 2-player game); then finish the round and everyone plays one more turn. Expansions (Australia, Court of Progress, Energy Research Institute, Gibraltar) may add scoring and are not modelled. Milestone tile conditions differ per segment and are not enumerated; scorer enters VP per marker.

sources.title: Nucleum Rulebook (EN, Awaken Realms)
sources.section: p.18-19 Milestone track; p.20 Endgame Conditions and Final Scoring; p.21 leftover resources, buildings, income tracks
